entities.title: Internal tools
entities.summary: The seven tools zazzled calls by name over the daemon socket: view, overview, find_symbol, changed_since, git_log, git_blame and report_gap. tools/list shows none of them; agents reach them through zazzle.
entities.purpose: Holds one class per tool behind the ITool contract, with the helpers they share: argument parsing (Args) and root:path references (RootSet). Each tool returns compact text and fills in a CallInfo for the usage log.
boundaries: The tools read the index (src/Index/) and the stored symbols (src/Analysis/, through Engine and Store); they never write the store.
Dispatch, timing and logging of a call are src/Mcp/; the tools only fill in CallInfo.
The view tool reads its file from disk and builds the view with src/View/; it does not use the index.

Agents never call these tools directly: zazzled offers them as zazzle_read (for .cs files), zazzle_overview, zazzle_find_symbol, zazzle_changed_since, zazzle_git_log, zazzle_git_blame and zazzle_report_gap (macos/rust/zazzled/src/cmd/structure.rs).
view resolves its path through Root.Resolve (src/Root.cs); git_log and git_blame do not (backlog.json, git-paths-unresolved).
